issues.description: The problem statement requires an instance method named checkOrderReady() in SealSaloon to serve queued meals FIFO and print readiness messages. In the solution, this required behavior is implemented in a method named processOrders(), and orderMeal() calls processOrders() instead of checkOrderReady(). This naming mismatch breaks alignment with the specified API and can cause students/tests expecting checkOrderReady() to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename processOrders() to checkOrderReady() and update orderMeal() to call checkOrderReady(); alternatively, add a public checkOrderReady() method that delegates to processOrders() and ensure orderMeal() calls checkOrderReady().
